description: Monitors semantic data changes and updates dependent pages

SDUIgnoredProperties.description: Property names whose changes alone must not trigger SDU. Defaults to SemanticExtraSpecialProperties' Revision ID property (___REVID), which - when enabled via $sespgEnabledPropertyList - changes on every single edit regardless of semantic content, verified empirically against a real installation. Harmless to keep if SemanticExtraSpecialProperties is not installed or ___REVID is not enabled.
